records.name: Bombay Flying Club
records.description: Bombay Flying Club, Mumbai is one of India's oldest and most established flying clubs, offering Commercial Pilot License training from Juhu Aerodrome.

records.name: Pearl Academy
records.description: Pearl Academy is a private design and fashion institution with campuses across India, offering undergraduate and postgraduate programs in fashion, media, design, and business.

records.name: Symbiosis Institute of Design Pune
records.description: Symbiosis Institute of Design, Pune is a reputed private design school offering undergraduate programs in communication, industrial, fashion, and space design under Symbiosis International University.

records.name: SP Jain Mumbai
records.description: S.P. Jain Institute of Management and Research, Mumbai is a leading private business school known for innovative MBA and PGDM programs with strong industry partnerships and global exposure.

records.name: NCTE Recognised B.Ed Colleges
records.description: NCTE Recognised B.Ed Colleges are institutions approved by the National Council for Teacher Education to offer the two-year Bachelor of Education degree for aspiring school teachers.

records.name: Coursera / edX MicroMasters
records.description: Online learning platforms offering MicroMasters and professional certificate programs from global universities, widely used by Indian learners for upskilling in technology, business, and data science.

records.name: XLRI
records.description: Xavier Labour Relations Institute, Jamshedpur offers finance and business management programs with a strong tradition of academic rigor, ethical grounding, and industry relevance.

records.name: Chennai Mathematical Institute
records.description: Chennai Mathematical Institute (CMI) is a leading research and education center in mathematics and computer science, founded in 1989. It offers BSc, MSc, and PhD programs in Mathematics, Computer Science, and Data Science, attracting top mathematical talent from across India. CMI is known for its rigorous academic environment and strong research output in pure and applied mathematics.

records.name: Amity University (Actuarial Science)
records.description: Amity University offers a specialized BSc and MSc program in Actuarial Science at its Noida campus, designed to prepare students for professional actuarial examinations. The program covers statistics, mathematics, finance, and insurance principles in alignment with IAI and international actuarial syllabi. Amity's strong industry connections provide students with internship and placement opportunities in insurance and financial services.

records.name: Bishop Heber College
records.description: Bishop Heber College, Tiruchirappalli, is an autonomous Christian minority institution affiliated with Bharathidasan University, established in 1966. It is known for its strong undergraduate and postgraduate programs in sciences, commerce, arts, and humanities, and has been accredited with 'A+' grade by NAAC. The college is particularly recognized for its mathematics, physics, and computer science departments.
